name: Giver
overview: Scripture reveals that giving is a blessed and essential act of obedience to God, exemplified by bringing tithes faithfully to His house, which prompts His abundant blessings (Malachi 3:10). True giving is to be done with sincerity and humility, not for public recognition, as God values the heart behind the gift (Matthew 6:1). The principle of generosity is assured with the promise that those who give will receive in overflowing measure, reflecting God's faithful provision (Luke 6:38). Ultimately, believers are called to support the weak and remember Christ’s teaching that it is more blessed to give than to receive, highlighting the spiritual joy and blessing found in selfless giving (Acts 20:35).
